acceptance: Independent API/CLI/MCP callers cannot borrow another principal, source account or secret.

positive.fixture: each surface accepts only its own credential; a caller runs in its own session; a confirmation works once for its caller and session

negative.fixture: 3x3 credential matrix, another caller's session and invocation, revoked/expired/removed callers, lost scope, borrowed or altered confirmation, echo scan for tokens and source identity

versions.primitive: confirmation digest now binds caller and session (deliberate incompatibility; none were issued before)

security_and_source_permissions: Credentials are 256-bit, stored as digests in a 0600 file, bound to one caller and surface; only a user-interface credential can issue a confirmation.
known_limitations: A person cannot confirm for an agent caller yet (VSF-B14-T06)
